summary: A Mandarin-speaking woman living in Germany vlogs a grocery trip: she returns deposit bottles, shops at LIDL for coconut-chicken ingredients while quoting prices, buys snacks at DM, then reviews her purchases and receipts at home.

questions.question: What colour/pattern is the tote bag she puts the empty bottles into before leaving home?
What cheese variety name is printed in large letters on the green pack of sliced cheese she picks up at the supermarket?
At DM she says she takes a pack of 'biscuits' (饼干). What product is actually shown in her hand?
questions.answer: Spelt mini pretzels (dm Bio 'Dinkel Mini Brezeln')
